Ornus | species = floribunda | authority = [[Nathaniel Wallich|Wall.]][http://www.forestrynepal.org/resources/trees/fraxinus-floribunda Fraxinus floribunda_Tree Information],'''www.forestrynepal.org''' }} '''''Fraxinus floribunda''''' is a species of [[ash tree|ash]] native to [[South Asia]], [[East Asia]], and [[Southeast Asia]]. It is known from [[Afghanistan]], [[Pakistan]], [[Nepal]], [[Assam]], [[Bhutan]], [[Laos]], [[Myanmar]] ([[Burma]]), [[Thailand]], [[Vietnam]], the [[Ryukyu Islands]], and parts of [[China]] ([[Guangdong]], [[Guangxi]], [[Guizhou]], [[Xizang]], [[Yunnan]], [[Zhejiang]]).[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=369761 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families, ''Fraxinus floribunda'' ][http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=210000553 Flora of China, v 15 p 276, ''Fraxinus floribunda''] ''Fraxinus floribunda'' is a medium-sized [[deciduous]] [[tree]] growing to 10–15 m tall with a trunk up to 50 cm diameter, with grey bark. Leaves opposite, pinnate, with 7–9 serrate leaflets. Flowers white, with petals 3–4 mm long, in large branched clusters up to 25 cm across. Fruit a nut, with a long narrow wing 2.5–4 cm long by 3–4 mm wide.[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/787427#page/155/mode/1up Wallich, Nathaniel, in Roxburgh, William. 1820.
